tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// bsnyen bsgrub gyi sa bcad bzhugs//

(1ba2)༄༅// "$ 'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i nye lam/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen rnams gshegs shul/ dbang rnon gyi gdams ngag tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sar skyel ba'i gdams ngag rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen bsgrub 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams ngag gnyis so// gnyis pa la smin byed dbang dang grol byed kyi lam gnyis so// gnyis pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis so// dang po la rgyu snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ lus ngag yid sbyang bar byed pa dben gsum gyi khrid dang lnga'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bsnyen sgrub gsum la brten nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bgrod/ lam de la bar chad med par bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan gyi gegs bsal/ gegs bsal mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob tshul bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po la/ lus rtsa dag par byed pa sku rdo rje bsnyen pa'i yan lag /ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yan lag /yid thig le dag par byed pa thugs rdo rje bsgrub pa chen po'i yan lag dang rnam pa gsum mo// dang po bsnyen pa la/ sor sdud/ de'i rtsar las/ 'bras bu bsam gtan dang gsum mo// dang po mthun pa'i rkyen/ bsgom pa'i (2na3)dus/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul dang gsum mo// de la mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis so// dang po la/ steng gi skyil krung la brten nas steng gi rlung bcing ba dang*/ 'og gi skyil krung la brten nas 'og gi rlung 'ching ba dang*/

bar gyi skyil krung la brten nas bar gyi rlung bcing ba dang gsum mo// de re re la'ang lus kyi byed bcings/ mig gi lta stangs/ sems kyi gzhag thabs dang gsum mo// gnyis pa ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yan lag la/ srog rtsol/ srog rtsol gyi 'bras bu 'dzin pa/ de gnyis kyi byed las/ byed las kyi bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhi'o// dang po la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rtsa mdud bshig pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang gsum mo// dang po la/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ rlung gi mal tshol ba gnyis so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'og thur sel la brten nas dkyil 'khor dang gdan gsal btab pa/ steng srog rtsol la brten sa yig 'bru bsgom pa/ bar rlung la brten nas phyag mtshan gsal btab pa/ kha sbyor la brten nas lha'i skur slong ba dang rnam pa bzhi'o// gsum pa la/ dngos dang*/ dar rlung gi gdams ngag zur bkol du bshad pa'o// bzhi pa la/ bskyed rim gyi sgom tshul/ de la brtan pa'i bzlas pa/ bzlas pa la brten pa'i 'phrin las sgrub tshul dang gsum mo// gsum pa de gnyis kyi byed las la/ byed chings la brten nas lus 'chi med du bsgrub pa/ gtum mo la brten pa thig le'i rnal 'byor/ thig le la brten pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor/ de gnyis kyi gegs sel ba byang sems 'gyur med/ 'chi kha ma'i rlung sems gang 'dod kyi (2ba4)gnas su 'phang ba'i man ngag dang lnga'o// de la 'chi ltas brtags nas 'chi ba bslu ba/ tshe sgrub gser srang ma/ ma lhus na 'chi kha ma'i rlung sems gang 'dod du 'phang ba gser srang ma'o// gsum pa yid thig le dag par byed pa thugs rdo rje sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag la/ 'jig rten pa'i lam rdzogs par bstan pa rjes dran/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rdzogs par bstan pa ting nge 'dzin gnyis so// dang po la/ dbang po rab gtum mo la brten pa/ dbang po 'bring dang lus la brten pa thig le'i rnal 'byor/

dbang po tha ma gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa spogs pa'i cho ga bstan pa dang gsum mo// gnyis pa la rang lus dngos dang*/ rigs bzhi/ mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag zur bkol du bshad pa'o// gsum pa la/ bsgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba/ gang la brten nas tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa gnyis so// dang po la/ lus zungs bskyed pa bcud len/ phyag rgya brtag pa/ dgug pa/ mi snang ba bya ba dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa gang la brten nas tshul ji ltar bsgrub pa/ rdo rje zla ba bcing ba/ rdo rje nyi ma dbang du byed pa gnyis so// dang po la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dbab pa/ gzung ba/ bzlog pa/ dgram pa/ rlung dang bsre ba'o// gnyis pa rdo rje nyi ma dbang du bya ba la sngon 'gro bsku mnye bya ba/ dngos gzhi rlung sbyang ba/ rjes kyi bya ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi rlung sbyang ba la/ rlung sbyang ba/ rdzas kyi rten 'brel bya ba/ de 'byongs nas pho nya mo'i bcud blang ba/ 'phros don sgra gcan gyi 'ching dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa lam de la bar chad med par bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba la/ gegs sel spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bstan pa gnyis so// dang po la/ (3na5)gegs sel snyan rgyud ma che ba/ gces phrug brgyad cu'i gegs sel/ gegs sel rin chen 'phreng ba/ gegs sel sman dpyad ma/ bla ma grags byang gi zhu lan/ gegs sel thor bu ba dang drug go// gnyis pa bye brag tu bstan pa la/ gyen du 'phang ba ha dmigs dang ltag 'then/ 'og tu 'bebs pas rgyal ba sdes zhus pa'i snyan rgyud ma chung ba gnyis/ thad kar gseng ba dbang phyug chos dang gsum mo// zla ba seng ge'i khrid yig gzhir bzhag bzhin pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la/ dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
